name: What is pipe bursting and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is pipe bursting and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pipe bursting is a trenchless method used to replace old or damaged underground pipes without extensive excavation. It involves pulling a new pipe through the path of the old one while simultaneously breaking apart the existing pipe. A cone-shaped bursting head is attached to the new pipe and pulled by a winch, fragmenting the old pipe into the surrounding soil. This process minimizes disruption to your property and landscaping, a significant advantage for homeowners in areas like Summerlin where property aesthetics are important.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pipe bursting is a trenchless method that replaces old pipes by pulling a new pipe through the path of the old one, breaking it apart underground. It minimizes excavation and disruption.
